cta.heading: Building something that needs to
cta.body: Marafis brings 20+ years of hands-on architecture and engineering leadership to enterprises that demand systems built for the long term.

hero.sub: Architecture decisions, cloud strategy, and engineering leadership — from the Marafis consultancy.

about.section-body-part1: Marafis is a specialist technology consultancy founded on a single conviction: that exceptional software and architecture decisions are the highest-leverage investment a business can make. We bring over two decades of hands-on engineering and technical leadership to every engagement.
about.section-body-part2: From greenfield platforms to complex legacy transformations - across finance, insurance, e-commerce, and telecoms - we've led the initiatives that matter most.
about.pillar-text1: We design before we build - ensuring every decision is intentional, documented, and aligned to your business goals.
about.pillar-text2: We don't hand off slide decks. Our consultants write code, lead teams, and stay accountable through delivery.
about.pillar-text3: We measure our success by yours - reduced time-to-market, lower operational risk, and platforms that last.

cta.section-body: Whether you're architecting a new platform, modernising a legacy system, or accelerating a cloud migration - Marafis brings the expertise to do it right.
cta.details: Get in touch to discuss your challenges. We offer an initial discovery conversation at no obligation - to understand your context and share how we might help.

hero.sub: We partner with forward-thinking enterprises to design, build, and evolve scalable technology platforms - from cloud-native architecture to AI-enabled transformation.

industries.industries-right-industries-quote: The best systems are those that remain comprehensible, adaptable, and trustworthy - long after the architects have left the room.
industries.industries-right-section-body: We bring domain literacy to every sector we serve. Understanding the regulatory, compliance, and operational pressures of your industry allows us to design systems that are not merely technically sound, but genuinely fit for purpose.

services.section-body: We bring decades of hands-on engineering and architectural leadership to every engagement - designing systems that are resilient, secure, and engineered for long-term growth.

solution.name: Solution & System Architecture
solution.description: End-to-end architecture design tailored to your business context — scalable, secure blueprints that form the backbone of your digital platform.

cloud.name: Cloud Transformation
cloud.description: Strategic migration and modernisation across AWS, GCP, and Azure — multi-cloud architectures designed for performance, cost efficiency, and resilience.

microservices.name: Microservices & Event-Driven Design
microservices.description: Decompose monoliths, design domain-driven services, and build event-driven architectures that scale independently and evolve with your organisation.

digital.name: Digital Modernisation
digital.description: Evolve legacy platforms into modern, maintainable systems — preserving business value while eliminating technical debt and unlocking new capability.

dev-ops.name: DevOps & Platform Engineering
dev-ops.description: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability platforms, and developer experience tooling that accelerate delivery and reduce operational risk.

ai.name: AI-Enabled Solutions
ai.description: Integrate AI and machine learning into your products and operations — from architecture advisory to building production-grade, AI-powered systems at scale.

approach.section-body: Every engagement follows a proven methodology — rigorous enough to produce consistent results, flexible enough to meet you where you are.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Deep-dive into your technology landscape, business context, constraints, and objectives to establish a shared foundation.

design.title: Architect
design.description: Produce rigorous architectural blueprints — decision records, trade-off analyses, and roadmaps with clear rationale.

delivery.title: Deliver
delivery.description: Hands-on implementation with embedded quality gates, iterative review cycles, and engineering excellence throughout.

evolution.title: Evolve
evolution.description: Ongoing advisory, observability review, and strategic guidance to ensure your platform continues to serve your ambitions.
